findings_to_judge.finding: FPDS-NG shows ZERO federal contract actions under 'C3.AI, INC.' signed between 2026-08-01 and 2026-09-02, against 3 actions in Aug 2025 (~$4.38M: $150.5k MDA 8/8, $0 USAF 8/18, $4.231M Army 8/27) and 3 in Aug 2024 - a break in the pattern in the month agencies obligate ahead of the 30 Sept federal year end, and the reported quarter itself contained only three actions, one of which was a 2026-07-03 DOE modification captioned 'DEOBLIGATE FUNDING AND DESCOPE REMAINING WORK' (-$625,000).

findings_to_judge.finding: C3's own Greenhouse ATS lists 67 open roles of which 11 are federal/defense-titled or Tysons, Virginia-based, including a newly created 'Senior Director, Product Management - C3 AI Defense and Intelligence', a 'Senior Director, Strategic Solutions - Intelligence Community', 'Senior Director, Strategic Solutions, Navy and Maritime Industrial Base', a dedicated 'Senior/Lead Site Reliability Engineer - Federal', and - the concrete tell - a second 'Executive Assistant to the CEO' posting based in Tysons, Virginia; 5 of the 9 quota-facing 'Strategic Solutions' openings are defense or intelligence specific, and 13 postings are Palantir-style 'Forward Deployed Engineer'/'Director, Forward Deployed Engineering' roles across New York, Chicago, Atlanta, Houston, London, Redwood City and Tysons.

The DEF 14A filed 2026-08-28 discloses that Condoleezza Rice, a director since 2009 and the company's most prominent Washington name, is not standing for re-election, and that Jim Hagemann Snabe is on a leave of absence from the board and also not standing - eleven weeks after C3 issued a press release celebrating Snabe's appointment as European Commission Special Envoy for Industrial AI - while the replacement director appointed 2026-08-25 with a $900,000 option grant, John C. Dwyer, is a high-stakes litigation partner at Cooley from 1998 to 2023 and a former Acting Associate Attorney General, seated alongside a brand-new General Counsel granted 826,901 RSUs effective 2026-07-30.
